senses.definition: n.m. soothsayer, magian (loan-word from Assyrian maḫḫû. soothsayer, DlHWB397; perhaps orig. Sumerian, DlHA14);—רַב־מָ֑ג Je 39:3, 13 chief-soothsayer, in train of Nebuchadrezzar.
